purpose: Screen original published experimental white-stork data and code access, distinct from repeated Adams radar retrospective summaries, before selecting a new PAYOFF-B cue/recourse test

earlier_sources.white_stork: Bontekoe et al. (2023), The price of being late: short- and long-term consequences of a delayed migration timing, Proceedings B DOI 10.1098/rspb.2023.1268
earlier_sources.payoff_v4_prior_art: docs/PAYOFF_B_V4_DIRECT_FITNESS_RESCUE_SCREEN_20261003.md already identifies causal delay, increased speed, changed wintering and survival as published results; neither novel correction discovery nor natural D_eff
earlier_sources.greater_snow_goose: Registered in PAYOFF-B as Movebank study 1442516400; authenticated metadata gate was CREDENTIALS_NOT_CONFIGURED (2026-10-01); don't download without owner permission

admission_tests.must_have_group_assignment: naturally timed / handling control / delayed release
admission_tests.must_have_predecision_cue_measure: raw staged information received or independent source-time context, not weather/hindsight at destination
admission_tests.must_have_action_measure: decision-specific stopover, departure, route or route switching
admission_tests.existing_published_results_cannot_be_new: survival difference, shorter stopovers, faster speeds, closer wintering

evaluation_rule: Classify each metadata gate as VERIFIED, NOT_VERIFIED, or BLOCKED. Metadata being visible never proves authorized tracking-data access. Do not call original result a new causal information-value test unless the source materially provides an independent predecision cue and decision-linked consequences.
output: Authenticated public DOI metadata and Zenodo original code manifest only, with access barriers; no original GPS rows or code archive contents committed
